_about: Narrative's draft of data/fight/style.json (Simulation's mood-style.md section 5), revision 3 after the M1b 100-match AI probe (2026-09-30). Percentages are integers, compared by cross-multiplication (100 * part > pct * whole). Times are seconds at the 1 Hz evaluation. Game Design owns the final numbers; Tools owns the schema. Every value is a placeholder for QA to tune.

mixer.definition: no dominant stance and a spread of attack kinds
mixer.leaveWhen: any other label enters, or the largest stance share exceeds 55 percent for 15 s

judgedOnAI.shortestLabelHeldS: at least 12 (minHeldS now guarantees 30 except at the end of a match)

judgedOnHumanOrScriptedPlay.everyLabelReached: scripted style bots (a turtler, a charger, a runner, a sniper) and playtests, not AI against AI
judgedOnHumanOrScriptedPlay.labelShares: a description of behaviour, not a target; report but do not band
